verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents workflow automation ('Trigger workflow', Blueprints, AI-driven bulk reminders/categorization) and MCP-based agent actions, suggesting automation depth, but no evidence explicitly describes scheduling recurring jobs, cron-like triggers, or persistent recurring workflows for AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/scheduled job API or documentation, evidence of interval-based triggers, and independent confirmation that AI agents can set up recurring automations.
